tests.name: CLEAN DOCUMENT: no unresolved cells, clean review queue
REVIEW_REQUIRED CELL: cell highlighted, in queue, count correct
SELECT ISSUE: coordinates, unit, and source page accessible
VALID HUMAN EDIT: persists HUMAN resolution, updates review_status = IN_PROGRESS
INVALID HUMAN EDIT: rejects 422, keeps persisted value unchanged
CONFIRM AS-IS PRIMARY: confirms Primary OCR candidate, marks HUMAN resolved
CONFIRM AS-IS SECONDARY: confirms current Secondary candidate without rollback
CANDIDATE MISMATCH: rejects 409 when cell has candidate mismatch
PLACEHOLDER: cannot edit or confirm placeholder, not in queue
COMPLETE REVIEW WITH BLOCKER: blocks 400 when blocking cells remain
COMPLETE REVIEW SUCCESS: marks document REVIEWED when all blockers resolved
EDIT AFTER REVIEWED: transitions review_status back to IN_PROGRESS
REFRESH BROWSER PERSISTENCE: refetching OCR data returns authoritative state
CLOSE AND REOPEN WORKSPACE: workspace reopened with consistent state
EXPORT AFTER HUMAN EDIT: exported Excel contains latest human edit value
DOUBLE CLICK SAVE: concurrent save calls remain consistent
DOUBLE CLICK CONFIRM: concurrent confirm calls remain idempotent
HUMAN REVIEW AI PROVIDER COUNT: Azure Primary = 0, Secondary = 0, Gemini = 0
